device.label: Tablet
device.description: Sets the display's resolution and size. Auto uses the resolution Moonlight asks for (set Moonlight to Native), falling back to the custom resolution before the first connection.

custom_resolution.label: Resolution
custom_resolution.description: The tablet's screen resolution in landscape, as WIDTHxHEIGHT, for example 2560x1600.

custom_diagonal.label: Screen size (inches)
custom_diagonal.description: The tablet's screen diagonal. Used to pick a sensible automatic scale; 0 means unknown.

audio.label: Play sound on the tablet
audio.description: Send the computer's audio to the tablet while streaming. Off keeps sound on the computer.

refresh_rates.label: Refresh rates
refresh_rates.description: Refresh rates the tablet display offers, comma-separated. The display uses the fastest one; 120 needs a GPU and port that can carry it.

method.label: How to add the display
method.description: Virtual uses the compositor's own virtual output (Hyprland, mango, sway). Port borrows an unused DP/HDMI connector through a small root helper (needed on niri; AMD and Intel graphics only).

port.label: Display port
port.description: Which unused connector the port method borrows, such as card2-DP-3. Auto tries free connectors on the GPU that drives the built-in screen first.

keep_sunshine.label: Keep Sunshine running when off
keep_sunshine.description: Off normally stops Sunshine so nothing can be streamed. Turn this on to leave Sunshine running as it was before, with your own Sunshine settings (which may stream your main screen).

panel.moonlight_help: On the tablet, add {host} in Moonlight, then start Desktop. Set Moonlight's resolution to Native.
panel.sunshine_missing: Sunshine isn't installed. Install it with your package manager (for example: sudo pacman -S sunshine), then open this panel again.
panel.helper_outdated: The port helper is out of date. Update it to keep Extend working.
panel.helper_needed: Extend on {compositor} borrows an unused display port, which needs a small helper installed once with sudo.

service.installing_helper: Installing the Tablet Display port helper (needs sudo).
